nextTask.goal: Build a pure read-only projection from stable local route agents into legacy macro traffic diagnostics/load without allowing macro edges, phases or district centres to influence local route choice or geometry.
actions: Implement the projection as a pure module; do not install it into MacroTrafficPoliceSystem yet.
Treat each route agent's compiler lane districtId/sourceRoadEdgeId as output metadata only; never derive a route transition from macro data.
Project district traffic counts directly from compiler lane district ownership.
For legacy macro-edge attribution, prefer explicit compatibility provenance if present; otherwise use sourceRoadEdgeIds only when the match is unique.
Classify zero-match and multi-match agents as unmatched/ambiguous instead of guessing a macro edge.
Conserve population: projected + ambiguous + unmatched must equal total input agents.
Do not synthesize a legacy phase from arbitrary world distance or macro centres; if phase compatibility is needed later it must come from explicit provenance/path mapping.
Add deterministic tests for unique, ambiguous and unmatched projection plus no mutation.
Keep visible traffic and macroTrafficPoliceSystem behaviour unchanged.
acceptance: projection never changes route-agent lane/connector selection
district counts are derived from compiler-owned local lane metadata
legacy macro edge attribution never guesses when source-road membership is ambiguous
total agent count is conserved across projected/ambiguous/unmatched buckets
no macro phase/world-coordinate steering is introduced
doNotAdvanceIf: projection requires macro district centres as local coordinates
an ambiguous local road is arbitrarily assigned to one macro edge
projection mutates agents, local topology or macro graph
the module is installed into live macro traffic before M3 shadow-mode work
